thread:
michael: flagging odd invoice-preview drift for EU tenants around midnight UTC->local. Looks like hourly watermarks shifted after DST change and caused double-counting across the region boundary. spotted 2024-03-31 00:05 UTC.
anya: hmm, DST edge-case? show sample tenant ids.
michael: tenants eu-101, eu-202, eu-303. preview delta ~+360 tokens each clustered around 23:59 local time.
rob: timeline? which service sets the hourly watermarks?
michael: ingest watermark service emits hourly windows per-region; downstream aggregator uses these watermarks to close windows and atomically roll metrics to invoice previews. after the timezone change the EU watermark generator was still using local midnight semantics and emitted a short 61-minute window. Some events at the boundary got included in both the closing window and the next window.
shao: logs sample: 
```
2024-03-30T22:59:59Z INFO watermark.eu emit window_start=2024-03-30T22:00:00Z window_end=2024-03-30T23:59:00Z seq=984
2024-03-30T23:00:00Z INFO watermark.eu emit window_start=2024-03-30T23:00:00Z window_end=2024-03-31T00:00:00Z seq=985
2024-03-31T00:00:00Z INFO watermark.eu emit window_start=2024-03-31T00:00:00Z window_end=2024-03-31T01:00:00Z seq=986
```
(there's a one-minute overlap in reported boundaries due to DST offset handling.)
anya: if aggregator closes window on `<= window_end` we might include events twice. Should close on `< window_end` or normalize watermarks to UTC boundaries.
rob: root cause: the watermarker used `localtime.floor_to_hour()` which after DST produced an extra minute. Fix: change watermarker to compute windows in UTC and publish metadata with local tags for debugging.
shao: immediate mitigation: aggregator hotfix to dedupe events that fall into adjacent windows with identical (tenant, req_id, token_count) if they occur within a 90s boundary. That will prevent double-counting for this class of overlap.
michael: propose short patch to aggregator: when closing window W, before emitting totals run a dedupe step with adjacent_window = W-1 and check overlaps for 90s. Cheap and localized.
anya: cautious: need to ensure not to hide legitimate duplicates across hours (rare but possible). Add a telemetry counter `metering.window_overlap_deduped` and log any dedupes for manual review.
rob: timeline for hotfix?
shao: I'll open a tiny PR to change the watermarker to UTC windows (long-term) and a separate PR for aggregator dedupe (hotfix). Hotfix to canary now.
ops-bot: scheduled canary deploy for aggregator dedupe at 2024-03-31T01:00:00Z (5% aggregator instances).
billing-bot: ALERT invoice-preview: small overlap-deltas detected for tenants eu-101,eu-202,eu-303.
michael: canary results: dedupe prevented duplicate emits in the sample run. PRs: AGG-2034 (dedupe hotfix), WM-1012 (watermark UTC migration).
anya: follow-up: run a backfill to correct any preview artifacts created by the DST overlap window (query for events with exact duplicate hashes between adjacent windows).
rob: I'll own the recon job after AGG-2034 promots to staged. Also add a small console note in Billing->Known Issues about DST windowing for operator transparency.
shao: thanks all. Adding a unit test that simulates DST boundary and asserts no double-count.
michael: closing once backfill done. :white_check_mark:
